3926.title: Relocated Claude skills retain the default root
3926.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude provider statically declares the default user skill directory alongside its environment-aware resolver; additive scanning retains both.
3926.proposedFix: Remove the static Claude user skill root, correct fixture expectations, and regenerate the affected golden.
3926.caveats: No PR: the required generated golden update is excluded by the simple-fix rule. Filesystem pipeline reproduced; UI and live CLI not exercised.
